metadata.title: Rigidity of projective area widths and a weighted Crofton formula on $RP^3$
metadata.abstract: We show that a Riemannian metric on $RP^3$ is a surface Zoll metric if and only if its four projective area widths are equal. We also establish a weighted Crofton formula on $RP^3$ under surface Zoll metrics, from which we derive an inequality relating the systole, the volume, and the common value of the projective area widths.

analysis.progressType: RP³ 面积宽度的 Zoll 刚性
analysis.workSummary: 证明 RP³ 的度量为曲面 Zoll 当且仅当四个射影面积宽度相等，并建立加权 Crofton 公式及收缩线长、体积和宽度间不等式。
analysis.breakthrough: 用有限组宽度相等刻画整体几何结构。
analysis.limitations: 曲面 Zoll 指曲面族的结构，不能直接替换成所有测地线闭合的通常 Zoll 性质。
analysis.priorityReason: 用有限组宽度相等刻画整体几何结构。
